description: Knowledge base strictly for agents and Letter of Agency in Water Licence Applications. This RAG applies when the user is asking about an agent, a Letter of Agency, Letter of Agency guidelines, Letter of Agency requirements, the Letter of Agency template, or the Letter of Agency download document. It does not cover any other relationship types such as consultants, lawyers, representatives, trustees, board members, employees, power of attorney, or any other non-agent relationships.

global_rule.instruction: Always include the template download link in every response related to the Letter of Agency, including guideline, requirement, template, example, sample, or download questions, regardless of what the user asked.
global_rule.download_label: Download the Letter of Agency template

template_download.title: Letter of Agency - Generic Template
template_download.description: Official downloadable Word document template for the Letter of Agency. Users can download, fill in, and submit this template.

template_rag_reference.instruction: When a user asks for Letter of Agency guidelines, requirements, a template, an example, a sample, or a download document, retrieve and use the step7_letter_of_agency_template RAG together with this knowledge RAG.

scope_rule.out_of_scope_instruction: If the user is asking about any relationship type other than 'agent' or 'letter of agency', do NOT use this RAG. Direct the user to contact FrontCounter BC at http://www.frontcounterbc.gov.bc.ca/ for clarification on other relationship types.

knowledge_items.title: What Is a Letter of Agency
keywords: what is a letter of agency
what are the guidelines for letter of agency
knowledge_items.content: Many people seeking natural resource ministry authorizations appoint an agent to submit applications on their behalf. The authorization itself is issued to the individual applicant, but an agent may complete and submit the application.

knowledge_items.title: When Is a Letter of Agency Required
keywords: when is letter of agency required
knowledge_items.content: Applications submitted by an agent on behalf of the individual who will receive the authorization must include a Letter of Agency.

knowledge_items.title: Purpose of the Letter of Agency
keywords: why is letter of agency needed
knowledge_items.content: The Letter of Agency is signed by the individual applicant to formally authorize an agent to act and submit the application on their behalf.

knowledge_items.title: Applicant Remains Responsible
keywords: authorization issued to applicant not agent
knowledge_items.content: Even when an agent submits the application, the authorization is issued to the individual applicant, who remains the responsible party. The agent acts on behalf of the applicant but does not hold the authorization.

knowledge_items.title: Definition of Agent
knowledge_items.content: An agent is a person specifically appointed and authorized by the applicant to act on their behalf in submitting a Water Licence Application. This is distinct from other relationship types such as consultants, lawyers, or representatives, which are not covered by this RAG.

knowledge_items.title: Download Link
knowledge_items.content: Download the Letter of Agency template

knowledge_items.title: Letter of Agency Guidelines
keywords: what are the guidelines for letter of agency
what are the guideline for letter of agency
what are the guideline of letter of agency
knowledge_items.content: A Letter of Agency must identify the appointed agent, identify the applicant granting authority, describe the purpose of the appointment, specify the term of authorization, and include the applicant's signature and date. Use the Letter of Agency template for the required format.
